description: This Java class defines a specific scenario (Scenario3Revoke16) for testing policy enforcers in a scenario where permissions are revoked. It sets up a test case to verify if a subject with revoked permissions on a resource hierarchy is prevented from accessing a subresource, using policy algorithms.

classes.name: Scenario3Revoke16
classes.description: A test scenario class that sets up a permissions revocation case to verify access control behavior based on policy algorithms.

methods.name: Scenario3Revoke16
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the testing scenario with specific resource permissions and policy validation.

methods.name: getSetup
methods.description: Returns the ScenarioSetup object configured for this test scenario.

methods.name: getApplyAlgorithmFunction
methods.description: Provides a function to apply the policy algorithm to check if the subject has permissions on the resource or any subresource.
